title: CityJSON Round-Trip — Load, Export, Re-Import
description: End-to-end check of the CityJSON exporter. Loads the LoD3 Railway CityJSON into a temporary SceneModel + DataModel, writes it back out with CityJSONExporter (each SceneObject a CityObject with a MultiSurface geometry, shared quantised vertices, materials, and the DataModel-derived city-object hierarchy), then re-imports the exported document into the displayed models. If geometry, transforms, materials and semantics survive the cycle, the re-imported model renders identically to the original.
